description: This PHP source file defines the DetailedTimesheetModel class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling detailed timesheet data in the Time API module. It implements serialization of DetailedTimesheet objects into arrays for API responses, including project, customer, activity, total duration, and daily timestamps with comments and durations.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed timesheet information into an array suitable for API responses, including nested project, customer, activity, total duration, and date-specific entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a DetailedTimesheet object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the DetailedTimesheet data into an array format, aggregating project, customer, activity, total duration, and per-date entries with comments and durations.
